body.purpose: Source Sans 3 for reading at counter distance.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Link card on the cream page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Dark olive pill used for the import action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #40442A; color: #F6F9E8; height: 4rem; padding: 0 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(64, 68, 42, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6A7147; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link input
components.description: Pill field for a recipe URL.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 4rem; padding: 0 1.25rem 0 3.5rem; border: 1px solid #D9CDB8; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #40442A; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5B5B5B; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #6A7147; border-color: #6A7147; }

components.name: Icon tile
components.description: Pending clay placeholder until a WebP icon is ready.
components.css: .ds-icon { width: 7rem; height: 7rem; border-radius: 1.75rem; background: #F6F9E8; box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -18px rgba(64, 68, 42, 0.7); display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-icon::before { content: ''; width: 4rem; height: 4rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #D4E28D; }

narrative.northStar: A clay figure on the counter
narrative.overview: Warm cream page, olive ink, lime used in small amounts, Fraunces headings, large pill controls.

rules.name: The Distance Rule
rules.body: Controls and body text stay large enough to read from 1 to 2 meters.

dos: Use cream #F3EDE3 as the page background.
donts: Do not set small olive text on cream.
Do not count icon generation as an import.
